summary: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026, announcing an exchange offer for all outstanding shares of its 9.375% Series D Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock. Each tendered preferred share will be exchanged for 5.5 newly issued shares of Series A Common Stock. The offer expires October 2, 2026, unless extended. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction is effectively a capital return via preferred-to-common conversion, reducing preferred dividend obligations while diluting common shareholders. What to watch: tender participation and any market reaction to dilution.
